name: Hunt for Yenniku
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
A doom, there is.  A doom on my chief's youngest son, Yenniku.  As is a custom with our people, he was given to the Gurubashi Trolls of Zul'Gurub, but after my tribe, the Darkspear tribe, left with the orc Thrall, poor Yenniku was lost to us.  I was sent from distant Orgrimmar, back to Stranglethorn, to search for my chief's son.

And I believe the Bloodscalp tribe has him.

If you would help me, then hunt the Bloodscalps.  You may find them to the north.  Gather their tusks and return to me.
narrative.objectives: Bring 9 Bloodscalp Tusks to Nimboya at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
These are good tusks, adventurer. You prove that you have the strength to hunt the Bloodscalps.

And that is good, because you are not done hunting them.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Champion. Show me you have made prey of the Bloodscalp tribe.

Show me your trophies.

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 34 to 46, 28,190 XP in all.

quests.name: Hunt for Yenniku
quests.objectiveText: Bring 9 Bloodscalp Tusks to Nimboya at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

quests.name: Headhunting
quests.objectiveText: Bring 20 Shrunken Heads to Nimboya at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

quests.name: Bloodscalp Clan Heads
quests.objectiveText: Bring Gan'zulah's Head and Nezzliok's Head to the bubbling cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

quests.name: Speaking with Nezzliok
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Balia'mah Trophy, a Ziata'jai Trophy and a Zul'Mamwe Trophy to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

quests.name: Speaking with Gan'zulah
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Skullsplitter Hunters, 6 Skullsplitter Headhunters, and 4 Skullsplitter Berserkers. Bring the Broken Armor of Ana'thek to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

quests.name: The Singing Crystals
quests.objectiveText: Bring 3 Pulsing Blue Shards to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

quests.name: The Mind's Eye
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Mind's Eye to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.

quests.name: Saving Yenniku
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.
